reel-2.facebook:
COMEX silver futures open interest routinely exceeds 1 billion ounces. Annual mine supply is around 800-850 million ounces. The paper market is larger than the physical metal it represents. Most price moves in silver happen in the futures market, not the physical market. That's the key thing to understand about silver price behavior.

iShares Silver Trust held over 550 million ounces of physical silver at its 2021 peak. That's roughly 65% of annual mine supply in one ETF. When money flows in, custodians must buy physical silver. When money flows out, they sell. That's why silver moves so hard when market sentiment shifts.
